text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Trainer Kiryuin and Trainer Kashimoto are two of my colleagues at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I speak to them about their respective partners and how much faith they have in them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We wish each other luck at the end of our passionate discussion, and I find that my belief in <chrname> is even stronger now!
